title: Adding Java Support
description:
Hello,
I will likely be putting a pull request on my own for this. But I do want to get C5.0 working for a Java environment. High level approach would be:

1- Add CMakeList.txt so the .c file can be converted to a shared library
2- Use Java Panama for the connection
3- Create a process that on releases, create the shared object file and jar file.

title: plot method fails when sample argument is set in `C5Control`
description:
The issue seems to be in conversion from C50 to party object.

```r
library("C50")
pen = na.omit(palmerpenguins::penguins)
C50::C5.0(species ~ ., data = pen) |> plot() # works

ctrl = C50::C5.0Control(sample = 0.8)
C50::C5.0(species ~ ., data = pen, control = ctrl) |> plot() # fails
# Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : Variable match was not found.

# problem occurs at conversion from C50 to party
C50::C5.0(species ~ ., data = pen, control = ctrl) |> C50:::as.party.C5.0()
# Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) : Variable match was not found.
```

title: #include <sys/unistd.h> is not portable, use #include <unistd.h>
description:
It is incorrect to include `<sys/unistd.h>`. The correct reference should be `<unistd.h>`. This allows the package to be built on more systems.

See https://github.com/topepo/C5.0/issues/18 for more details.

https://github.com/topepo/C5.0/blob/29306b5df1d1c070174a0b5c9a564b042f00ffad/src/rc50.c#L37
